requirements.title: Explicit attribute specification is unique within a scoping unit
requirements.definition: An entity cannot be explicitly given an attribute more than once in a scoping unit. The scope-wide relation includes repetitions across statements; C801 remains the specific same-type-declaration-statement attr-spec owner. An implication or default is not a second explicit specification, and an authorized override/confirmation must retain its own premises. Repeated identical values are not exempt, and changing the explicit value does not automatically make a second specification an allowed override.

requirements.title: A nonallocatable nonpointer function result uses an explicit-shape list
requirements.definition: When an array-spec is supplied for a function result that is neither ALLOCATABLE nor POINTER, that array-spec is an explicit-shape-spec-list. The exact syntactic category matters: a vector explicit-shape-bounds-spec is not that list, even though other contexts can use it to describe explicit shape. Explicit shape need not have constant bounds. Result attributes and the definition of the returned value retain15.6.2.2's requirements.
